title: AgentVQA: The Blind Spot of Autonomous Vision

beats.text: Before you choose your foundation model, look at how AgentVQA beats the leader by 58.5%.
beats.visual_focus: A robot arm hovering over a UI, glitching through a digital overlay.

beats.text: The villain is temporal state discontinuity. Models treat dynamic video like a security guard watching a feed that only refreshes once every ten minutes.
beats.visual_focus: A split screen showing a smooth video vs. a stuttering, frame-dropped security feed.

params.barrier_sub: Unscalable rollout costs & zero unified rankings

motif_params.barrier_sub: Unscalable rollout costs & zero unified rankings

beats.text: AgentVQA shatters this wall by curating 1,000 high-stakes, real-world scenarios across web, robotics, and games to force models to actually see.
beats.visual_focus: A data-grid showing 1,000 distinct agentic scenarios being indexed.

feynman_certification.listener_verdict: The hook was solid—it hit that 'wait, my agent is actually blind?' nerve immediately. I liked that you didn't waste time with a 'Hey guys' intro. Beat 4 got a little dense with the 'bounding box regression' mention; I know what that is, but it felt like you were just throwing jargon at the wall to sound smart. The rest was clean and actually explained why these models fail.
